name: Stroller
summary: Baby pram or pushchair with a hood, basket, handle and four wheels, in side view facing right; a prop.

params.name: y
params.note: ground line: the wheels touch y

params.name: s
params.note: scale; at s = 1 about 500 px wide and 600 px tall (hero size)

params.name: anim
params.note: drive = wheels spin and the pram rocks (also on when vx is not 0)

params.name: vx
params.note: horizontal speed in px per frame (negative = left; set flip too)

params.name: flip
params.note: mirror so the stroller faces left

author: krakujs
